result.rationale: The diff changes `evt.destinationCalendar?.integration !== "google_calendar"` to destructuring `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = evt.destinationCalendar ?? [];` followed by non-optional access `mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration !== "google_calendar"`. When destinationCalendar is null/empty (as now possible, e.g. handleNewBooking sets `destinationCalendar: ... : null`), mainHostDestinationCalendar is undefined and `.integration` throws a TypeError instead of falling back to daily video. Real regression introduced by this diff.
